summary: Comprehensive testing of iteration 11 completed. Two features tested: (1) ResumeBuilder refactoring from 1040-line monolith to 8 focused sub-components - all tabs work correctly (Personal, Experience, Education, Skills, Extras), score panel updates, live preview reflects data. (2) Location-based salary guides (420 new pages = 14 salary amounts × 30 cities) - all render correctly with COL index, purchasing power, rent burden, state tax info, and cross-city comparison links.
passed_tests: Test 1: Resume Builder page loads with all sub-components (header, reset button, template selection, 5 tabs, score panel, preview)
Test 2: Resume Builder Personal tab - fill name, email, phone, location - live preview updates correctly
Test 3: Resume Builder Experience tab - add experience entry with job title, company, dates, description
Test 4: Resume Builder Education tab - add education entry with school, degree, field, dates
Test 5: Resume Builder Skills tab - add multiple skills (JavaScript, React, Python, Node.js)
Test 6: Resume Builder score panel updates as data is added (10 → 20 → 32 → 15)
Test 7: Resume Builder live preview reflects all entered data
Test 8: Location salary page /guides/80000-salary-in-san-francisco renders with COL index 179, state tax 7.2%, rent burden table
Test 9: Location salary page /guides/100000-salary-in-austin shows 'no state tax' correctly for Texas
Test 10: Location salary pages show 'in Other Cities' comparison links
Test 11: Guides Hub shows new 'Salary by City' section with 30 city cards
Test 12: Sitemap stats GET /api/sitemap/stats returns 707 total guides and 420 location salary guides
Test 13: Sitemap XML GET /api/sitemap.xml contains location salary URLs (842 total URLs)
Test 14: Old salary guide /guides/50000-salary still works
Test 15: Old mortgage guide /guides/mortgage-300000 still works
Test 16: Old debt guide /guides/pay-off-10000-debt still works
Test 17: Old freelancer guide /guides/self-employment-tax-100000 still works
test_credentials: No auth required - all pages are public
seed_data_creation: None required - all data is generated dynamically from datasets
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 11 tested two features: (1) ResumeBuilder refactored into 8 sub-components under /components/career-tools/resume/ - types.ts, ResumeScorePanel.tsx, ResumePreview.tsx, PersonalTab.tsx, ExperienceTab.tsx, EducationTab.tsx, SkillsExtrasTab.tsx.
